spans.s:
ADVANCE (v. i.):
I To move forward:
(1)
प्रयाति,
the chariot a. d towards Kṛṣṇa
अभिशौरि
 रथः प्रययौ, Si. xx. 2.;
(2) उच्चलति (चल्, c. 1),
I a. d three or four steps
त्रिचतुराणि पदान्युदचलम्,
D. ii.;
(3) अभि-याति (या, c, 2), अभ्या-गच्छति
(गम्, c. 1), etc. (with acc.),
at once a. d
against the lords of the quarters
सपदि ककुभामीशान-
मभ्यागमत्, Ku. xvi. 50.;
(4) अभिमुखं याति, व्रजति,
etc.,
should a. against the enemy
द्विषतोऽभिमुखं
 व्रजेत्, Ka. xviii. 2. Ph.
the day has a. d
दूरमधि-
रुढः सविता Sa. iv.
II To make progress:
q. v.: Ph. with his age, he a. d in knowledge
वयसा सह ञ्जानमस्य ववृधे। Ph.: of a. d age:
(1)
गतवयस्, H. ;
(2) गलितवयस्, R.;
(3) परिणत-
वयस्, K.

ADVANCE (v. t.):
I To bring forward
अभिमुखं चालयति (c. of चल्)
or
नयति (नी,
c. 1.)
II To promote, forward: q. v.:
वर्द्धयति (c. of वृध्)
III To offer or propose (as
an opinion): q. v.
IV To pay before-
-hand: Ph.
a. d 500 rupees for the bridge
*सेतु-
बन्धनार्थं पञ्चशतरूप्यमुद्राः प्रागेव दत्तवान्।

ADVANCE (subs):
I Onward movement:
(1) प्रयाणम्। v. Going;
(2) आगमनम्। v. Coming.
II Progress, improvement: q. v.: उन्नतिः।
III Increase of price:. वृद्धिः।
IV A
paying beforehand: अग्रिमदानम् (?).

ADVANCED-GUARD: नासीरचराः (m. pl.) (after
Vi.) and sim. comp.

ADVANCEMENT:
(1) उन्नतिः।
(2) अभ्युदयः: v.
Promotion.

ADVANTAGE (subs)
I Benefit:
(1) हितम् (=good
q. v.),
for whose a.
कस्य हिताय;
(2) लाभः
(=profit, q. v.),
what a. will you derive
*तव
 को लाभो भविष्यति;
(3) गुणः = merit, q. v.). they []
do not know the a. s of riding
*अश्वारोहणतुणान्न
 जानन्ति।
II Opportunity: q. v.: अवसरः।
III
Superiority: Ph.
the enemy had the a. of
us in number
शत्रूणां संख्यास्मदधिकासीत्।

ADVANTAGE (v. t.): उपकरोति (कृ, c. 8): v.
To profit.

ADVANTAGEOUS:
(1) हितकर: (री, रं): v.
Beneficial;
(2) लाभावहः (हा, हं) v. Profit-
-able;
(3) अर्थकरः (री, रं) (=enriching) To
be a.: v. To advantage.

ADVANTAGEOUSLY:
I Profitably: q. v.
II
Conveniently: q. v.
ADVENT: आगमनम्: v. Arrival.

ADVENTURE:
I Risk, hazard: q. v.
II A
remarkable achievement:
(1) अद्भुतं कर्म,
although a boy, Rama is celebrated for his
a. s
रामः कर्मभिरद्भुतैः शिशुरपि ख्यातः, Vi. iii.;
(2) चरितम्, (=the sum total of one's a. s)
the a. s of the ten princes
दशकुमारचरितम्।
III
Accident: q. v.
ADVENTURE: v. To venture, dare.

ADVENTURER: साहसिकः (की, कं). A military
a.: v. Freebooter.

ADVENTUROUS: साहसिकः (की, कं): v. Bold,
rash.

ADVERB: क्रियाविशेषणम्। Ajal: *क्रियाविशेषकः
(का, कं).

ADVERSARY:
(1) वैरिन् (m);
(2) विपक्षः v.
Opponent, enemy.
ADVERSATIVE: *विरोधसूचकमव्ययम् यथा — ‘तु’, ‘तथाच’।

ADVERSE:
(1) प्रतिकूलः (ला, लं);
(2) विपक्षः
(क्षा, क्षं): v. Inimical, hostile.

ADVERSITY:
(1) विपद् (f);
(2) आपद् (f): v.
Calamity, misfortune.

ADVERT TO:
(1) उदाहरति (हृ, c. 1.):
if in
course of conversation, people were to a. your
name
कथाप्रसङ्गे न जनैरुदाहृतात् तवाभिधानात्, Ki. i.
24;
(2) उत्-लिखति (लिख्, c. 6): v. To
notice, allude.
ADVERTENCE: अवधानम्: v. Attention, notice.

ADVERTISE (v. t.):
I To inform: q. v.: ञ्जपयति
(c. of ञ्जा).
II To publish a notice of:
(1)
*वि-ञ्जापयति (c. of ञ्जा);
(2) *धोपयति (धुष्,
c. 10): Ph.
a. d a horse for sale in the Soma
Prakasa
*विक्रेयो घोटक
इति सोमप्रकाशपत्रि

कायां विञ्जा-
पयामास।
ADVERTISER: *घोषकः।

ADVICE:
I Counsel:
(1) उपदेशः;
(2) शासनम्;
(3) अनुशासनम्। To give a. may be expr. by
शास्ति etc.:
what sort of friend is he who does
not give good a. to his master
स किंसखा साधु न
 शास्ति योऽधिपम्, Ki. i. 5: v. To advise.
II
Intelligence: q. v. संवादः।

ADVISABLE: युक्तः (क्ता, क्तं) B. xii. 15. v. Pru-
-dent, expedient.
ADVISABILITY: औचित्यम्: v. Expediency.

ADVISE (v. t.)
I To give advise:
(1) उप-
दिशति (दिश्, c. 6). there is nothing to a. you
ते नाल्पमप्युपदेष्टव्यमस्ति, K. ;
(2) शास्ति, अनु-,
(शास्, c. 2),
a. me what is to be done with
this wealth
किं विधेयमनयार्थसम्पदा, शाधि॥॥मां, Si.
xiv. 11. N. B. These verbs may take two
acc. s.
II To inform: q. v.: ञ्जापयति (c. of ञ्जा).

ADVISEDLY: v. Designedly, purposely. Ph.
a. cruel
प्रतिपत्तिनिष्टुरः, R. viii. 65.

ADVOCACY: No equiv.: *अभिभाषणम्: v. Defence,
vindication, recommendation.

ADVOCATE (v.): *अभिभाषते (भाष्, c. 1): v. To
plead, defend, vindicate.

ADVOCATE (subs):
I A pleader: *अभिभाषकः;
 उकिलः:
II. A. defender, vindicator: q. v.
*अभिभाषकः।
ADVOWEE: *धर्मवृत्तिदः (दा, दं).
ADVOWSON: *धर्मवृत्तिदानम्।
